## Astraeus 2.7.1

### Changed
- **The sung line in vinyl mode is its own part.** In Edit fullscreen it moves and resizes on its own, apart from the song's name and album, and by default it sits clear of them.
- **The pill keeps its own bars.** Turning on the waveform look for the Media page no longer turns the pill's little bars into a waveform.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
